summary.en: Ran and Conan are on a train and are confronted by a pickpocket but is saved by an elderly man named Tokuma Norizuki. Location: Inside train Culprit: Kousuke Maeda Maeda pickpocketed the businessman but got arrested by Tokuma Norizuki. As the train passes Sugame Station, they notice the police investigating something under the railway. Ran and Conan discover that a man named Kanemura, a local con artist, was killed by a head injury. Location: Near the Sugame station Victim: Tsuneo Kanemura Cause of death: Blow to the head Suspects: Teruhiko Kiriya Norizuki claims he witnessed Kanemura's boss, Teruhiko Kiriya, committed the murder. Kiriya said he was called to the crime scene by Kanemura's friend and proclaims he is not the culprit. Conan asks Takagi to investigate on Norizuki and learns that Norizuki's girlfriend, Mitsu, was a victim to their con artist group which resulted in her death.
